case_number: 2024 INSC 429; REVIEW PETITION (C) No. 1025 of 2019 IN CIVIL APPEAL NO. 6567 OF 2014
summary: Review petition challenging Supreme Court's prior order setting aside Punjab & Haryana High Court judgment; scope of second appeals under Section 41 Punjab Courts Act 1918 versus Section 100 CPC; reappreciation of evidence impermissible in second appeal; Pankajakshi Constitution Bench precedent confirms High Court cannot overturn first appellate findings on fact; substantial questions of law not required under Punjab Act; Will validity challenged as surrounded by suspicious circumstances but not proved; petitioner's natural succession claim; final judgment sustains dismissal of respondents' case.
final_judgment: Review petition allowed; Civil Appeal No. 6567 of 2014 set aside; High Court judgment restored; respondents' Will declared unproved; property succession granted to petitioner through natural inheritance.
